verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents running parallel attempts. `/fork` branches a session into a peer, worktree sessions isolate parallel agents so they cannot overwrite each other's files, and the dashboard shows every session's status. Nothing documents comparing the attempts' results side by side or selecting one to keep. missing for 10: documented side-by-side comparison or diff of attempt outputs, a choose/merge-winner workflow, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: `/fork [directive]` branches the current session into a peer that starts from a copy of the conversation.
A worktree session runs in an isolated copy of your repository, so parallel agents cannot overwrite each other's files.
The dashboard is a fullscreen overview of every session: which agents need input, which are working, and which are done.
